text:
andre: Heads up — after upgrading redwood-python-sdk to 1.17.0 my streaming calls seem to replay the initial request (i'm seeing duplicate billing lines), and clients fall into long retry loops. anyone else?

lina: Which exact call and how are you initializing the client?

andre: Quick repro: pip install redwood-sdk==1.17.0 then run our simple stream:```py
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=ENV['RW_API_KEY'])
for chunk in cli.chat.stream(model='rw-4', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}]):
    print(chunk)
```
I see the same first token sequence twice and then repeated 429/500 retries in logs.

mike_support: Thanks, andre — can you paste the minimal log lines (request ids) and your requirements/pip freeze? also, did you have any custom retry config?

andre: logs: ```
INFO  request_id=rc-01G8ZAB2 user_request=start model=rw-4
WARN  request_id=rc-01G8ZAB2 transient error 500, retrying
INFO  request_id=rc-01G8ZAB2 duplicate send detected
ERROR request_id=rc-01G8ZAB2 billing_event=charged tokens=42
```
pip freeze: redwood-sdk==1.17.0
no custom retry config, default client.

kevin_eng: This sounds like the client started reusing a "timeout_ms" arg that was renamed to "timeout" in 1.17 and we accidentally introduced a code path that re-sends the initial chunk when the socket times out then reconnects. Quick workaround: pin to 1.16.3 or set env var RW_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS to force the old code path.

andre: pin helped, rolling back to 1.16.3 clears the double-send. can you confirm visible fix plan? customers hit unexpected billing.

kevin_eng: Filed an internal bug (ENG-9852) and adding a high-priority rollback patch. For support threads: recommend pinning to 1.16.3 and setting a short client-level timeout to avoid long retry loops: ```bash
pip install redwood-sdk==1.16.3
export RW_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS=5000
```

sophie_pm: Escalating to infra and billing — can support collect affected customer ids and ASA logs so billing can reverse duplicates? @mike_support can you coordinate? :pray:

mike_support: On it. raising billing ticket and asking affected customers for request ids and timestamps. also attaching this thread to the support ticket.

support-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-2026 linked to ENG-9852. Priority: P1.

andre: thanks everyone — i left repro and my minimal logs in the ticket. will test patch when available. :thumbsup:

kevin_eng: We'll aim to ship a patch tonight and cut a 1.17.1 that preserves backward-compatible timeout arg and avoids the reconnect double-send. I'll post update in this thread when merged.

lina: Noted — will add a short KB article for customers about pinning and env workaround until patch is out.

kevin_eng: follow-up note for engineers: check streaming socket reconnect path + ensure initial-chunk is idempotent or guarded by a single-send flag.

andre: confirmed last_message: rolling back is safe for us for now. thanks.
